structure.prompt: EDIT TARGET: image 1, the wide lower panel of a Kalistar fantasy card. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for the existing materials and the fine blue leather/grain of the MOMO name strip. Output ONLY the redesigned lower panel, same wide 765:370 proportions, no full card. Task: refine this exact ornamental design with professional finish, not reinvent it. Retain its layered rose-bronze / muted copper edging, bevelled antique metal with realistic subtle reflections, dark ink-blue enamel, compact silhouette and decorative lower corner details. The outline must be clean, meticulously connected and bilaterally symmetric, solid forged metal, with no broken thin lines or stray spurs. Not a flat vector graphic or website panel; maintain the tactile depth and soft material highlights of the source. The complete panel must fill the canvas edge to edge in the same position as image 1; do not add surrounding margins. Layout expressed relative to 765x370: a narrow horizontal version-title strip at y0..60, dark finely pebbled blue leather exactly in the spirit of the top MOMO strip, an empty circular weapon medallion centered (80,103), and identical empty race medallion centered (685,103), each outer diameter130. Keep both medallions fully visible, slightly overlapping the ends of the version band just like the source. Elegant connected mouldings descend from the medallions into the lower text panel with the same stepped/chamfered source vocabulary. A clear dark blue band between the two medallions at y72..152 for profession and race labels; keep its top line continuous. Center between them at (382.5,127): a dark EMPTY recessed mounting space where the existing elemental hexagonal crystal will later be placed. Do not generate a crystal, gem or large central medallion. Completely remove the AIR/ROCHE affinity row and its horizontal separator; absorb its space into the seamless composition, allowing a generous single blank dark-blue narrative area at x80..685, y202..326. Preserve the source bottom corner hardware but simplify it into two identical carefully crafted embossed bronze fittings. All text, all symbols, all icons, guitar, robot, crystal and colored affinity words MUST BE REMOVED, leaving clean blank surfaces for later editable content. Absolutely no writing, glyphs, pseudo-letters, numerals or watermark. Avoid pale flat pink outlines, modern UI rectangles, repetitive nested plain polygons, thick blocky borders, black wide margins, shiny yellow gold, added fantasy emblems, extra sockets. The result should be the same Kalistar card panel made by a meticulous artisan: richer material finish, precise joins, recognizable structure.

energy.prompt: Asset type: ONE blank electric stat disk for the Kalistar card, transparent PNG, orthographic front view, no text or numbers. Image 1 is the reference to KEEP for the energy: lively thin branching yellow-white lightning arcs, jagged intersecting filaments, an electrically charged corona rather than a solid metal border. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for its quiet dark charcoal/olive textured central filling. DISCARD all gold metal, crystals, facets, spikes and jewelry from image 2. Create their marriage: a perfectly round OPAQUE dark charcoal-olive disk with subtle smoky mineral texture, surrounded and partially enveloped by energetic golden-yellow electricity like image 1. The electricity itself creates the edge; NO physical metal rim, NO bronze circle, NO gemstones, NO hard crown, NO sawtooth border. The disk must completely cover the old ordinary stat socket underneath when composited. Disk diameter around 70% of square canvas, electric filaments and soft luminosity out to 88%. A concentrated bright double corona along the circular edge, with a few fine elegant branching bolts escaping irregularly. Strong sense of energy, light in motion captured as a still image, not a manufactured emblem. The dark center stays calm and very legible for white numbers; no large lines crossing its central 65%. Subtle yellow light enters the disk near the perimeter but no bright yellow cloudy fill in the middle. Similar painterly fantasy craft and lively electric glow to reference1. True transparent outside; not a black square, no solid backdrop or checkerboard. SINGLE centred circle only, no letters, numerals, logos or extra ornaments.
